message.deepcharter.repair.bad_amount: That is not an amount of hull to repair
message.deepcharter.repair.bolt_already: A roof bolt already holds this stretch
message.deepcharter.repair.bolt_no_room: No room to set a bolt there
message.deepcharter.repair.bolt_forbidde: You cannot build here, so you cannot set a roof bolt here
message.deepcharter.repair.bolt_none: No bolts: buy a pack at the repair station
message.deepcharter.repair.bolt_not_rock: Nothing to bolt to: set it in bare rock overhead
message.deepcharter.repair.bolt_on_foot: The bolt driver works on foot: climb out of the pod
message.deepcharter.repair.bolt_set: Roof bolt set: it holds the roof round it
message.deepcharter.repair.cargo_unreada: The cargo bay cannot be read, so nothing can be teleported
message.deepcharter.repair.charge_hull_l: Hull too low to set a charge: the blast and the drop into its hole would wreck you. Repair first
message.deepcharter.repair.charge_no_com: No Company rock below to blast: use dynamite for plain rock
message.deepcharter.repair.charge_not_re: Set the charge while the pod rests on its slab
message.deepcharter.repair.charge_opens_: Lava under the rock: a shaped charge would open it. Use a blasting charge instead
message.deepcharter.repair.charge_set: Charge set: CLIMB CLEAR, blast in %s
message.deepcharter.repair.engine_clean: The engine has no soot to clear
message.deepcharter.repair.engine_unread: This engine has data from another version of the mod
message.deepcharter.repair.no_pod: No pod of your charter is parked at the station
message.deepcharter.repair.not_piloting: Use this item while you pilot a pod
message.deepcharter.repair.tank_full: The fuel tank is already full
message.deepcharter.repair.throw_from_se: Climb out to throw this: it is thrown by hand, on foot
message.deepcharter.repair.thrown_flare_: The flare finds no footing and goes out: it is back in your pack
message.deepcharter.repair.thrown_charge: Charge down: GET CLEAR, blast in %s
message.deepcharter.repair.unknown_item: The station does not sell that
message.deepcharter.repair.wreck: A wreck cannot be repaired here: only the hangar can restore it
screen.deepcharter.repair.intro: Emendation Station online. Park your pod beside it to repair the hull. Each point has its price on the button. Suit tiers pay off from layer 3 down.
screen.deepcharter.repair.no_pod: No pod of yours is parked here
message.deepcharter.repair.recovery_call: Stranded: winch in %ss, $%s. Refuel to cancel
message.deepcharter.repair.recovery_shor: Winched home. Paid $%s of $%s; hull took the rest
message.deepcharter.repair.service_canno: The account cannot pay for a litre of soot ($%s). SCRAPE FLUE is free, and slow
message.deepcharter.repair.scrape_not_li: The flue needs scraping only when the engine is in limp mode at the colony
message.deepcharter.repair.scrape_runnin: The flue is already being scraped
message.deepcharter.repair.scrape_left: Flue scrape stopped: you left the station. Nothing was cleared
message.deepcharter.repair.scrape_pod_le: Flue scrape stopped: the pod left the station. Nothing was cleared
message.deepcharter.repair.scrape_done: Flue scraped: %s L of soot left. The pod can launch, slowly. A service cleans it
